Agent view: life.ayushrai.site

Public knowledge site for an AI Engineer in Bhopal. Machine-readable agent view of profile, projects, products, contact, API, MCP, sandbox, SDK, and CLI.

Identify Ayush Rai, quote public projects and products, fetch published contact details, call the ask endpoint, sandbox, jobs API, product MCP, or docs MCP. Do not invent metrics or send messages as him.

API endpoints

Base URL https://life.ayushrai.site. Contract: https://life.ayushrai.site/openapi.json.

MethodPathPurposeResponses
GET/askAsk a public question200, 400
POST/askAsk a public question as JSON200, 400
GET/api/v1/sandboxSandbox of public facts200
POST/api/v1/batchAnswer up to 10 public questions in one request200, 400
POST/oauth/registerSelf-serve public client registration (RFC 7591)201, 400
POST/oauth/tokenExchange for the public-read bearer token200, 400
GET/api/v1/jobsDescribe the async job pattern200
POST/api/v1/jobsAccept a batch of public questions and return a poll URL202, 400
GET/api/v1/jobs/{job_id}Poll an async ask job200, 404
GET/api/v1Protected public-read API200, 401

Authentication

public reads
No token for /ask, /llms.txt, markdown pages, /api/v1/sandbox, /api/v1/batch, or /api/v1/jobs.
protected resource metadata
https://life.ayushrai.site/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
authorization server
https://life.ayushrai.site/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
auth guide
https://life.ayushrai.site/auth.md
sandbox
https://life.ayushrai.site/api/v1/sandbox
methods
none for public reads; self-serve registration: POST /oauth/register (RFC 7591); Bearer public-read from POST /oauth/token for /api/v1; anonymous register at /agent/identity
registration endpoint
https://life.ayushrai.site/oauth/register
token endpoint
https://life.ayushrai.site/oauth/token

Pricing, limits, and versioning

pricing
free; signup required: no; https://life.ayushrai.site/pricing.md
rate limit
120 requests per 60s; headers RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset
versioning
url-path (v1); policy https://life.ayushrai.site/developers/deprecation
errors
JSON with error.code, error.message, error.status, error.hint; https://life.ayushrai.site/developers

Capabilities

  • public profile and biography
  • projects and products
  • published contact details
  • NLWeb ask endpoint with optional SSE streaming
  • read-only sandbox
  • batch public questions
  • async jobs with HTTP 202 Accepted and Location poll URL
  • product MCP and docs MCP
  • markdown negotiation
  • structured JSON API errors
